title: Auto ride home
blurb: Flag an auto, set the meter, give directions and ask for change.

steps.scene: You spot an empty auto at the roadside and wave it down.
steps.goal: Ask the driver: Will you come?

steps.scene: He nods. Before you climb in, you want a fair fare.
steps.goal: Ask him to put the meter on

steps.scene: The road ahead is clear. You want him to keep going.
At the junction, your street is on the left.
There is your gate. Time to get off.
He tells you the fare, and you only have a big note.

title: Meet the neighbour
blurb: Say hello, ask how she is and swap names on the stairs.

steps.scene: You meet a friendly neighbour on the stairs.
She smiles. You would like to know how she is.
You realise you have not been introduced.
She tells you her name, then waits for yours.
It is time to head upstairs.
